elevate.move: Break the five-stop zigzag into a river you travel down: the St. Johns line crosses the page diagonally, each stop moors on whichever bank the river is on at a different scale (Riverside a large lead stop with a 2x drawing, Springfield + San Marco paired, The Beaches opening wide where the river meets the Atlantic) - five shapes, one route.

Let the river reveal the second photo too: the oak break opens through the route line widening into a sash-proportioned window clip tied to --sw-p, both frames in one cool moss/river grade, and the hero panes re-cropped so the house, not the hedge, is the subject.
